subtitle: Flashcards + AI mock interview
promotionalText: New: Interview Lab, with worked answers for system design, coding and SQL. And Role Ready: type any role and get about 25 cards for it.
description:
Your interview is coming up. PrepPilot makes sure it all comes back to you.

Short flashcards for the tech you already work with, in the order interviewers ask, plus worked answers and a voice mock interview when you want to say it out loud.

FLASHCARDS THAT FIT YOUR ROLE
• Pick your roles (backend, cloud, SRE, data, DevOps, mobile and more) and get a plan built from your stack
• Swipe right on what you know, left on what you don't; the misses come back first
• Every answer has a Why, an Example and the Trap interviewers listen for

ROLE READY
• Type any role, such as "Site reliability engineer", and get about 25 cards across its key skills
• Or paste a job post and get a deck for every skill it will test, from basics to real scenarios

INTERVIEW LAB
• Classic questions in system design, coding, SQL, low-level design and behavioral
• Try it yourself first and get it checked, then see the worked answer step by step

LIVE AI
• A spoken mock interview with an AI interviewer, any time
• Pause whenever you like; only the time you talk counts

ALSO
• An AI coach to explain anything simply or grade your answers
• Text size, light and dark mode, and your progress saved to your account

PREPPILOT PRO
Unlock every topic and card, unlimited AI coach messages, Role Ready, the full Interview Lab and 30 Live AI minutes a month. $6.99 a month after a 3-day free trial for new subscribers. A one-time 60-minute Live AI session is also available.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple ID account settings.

Terms of Use: https://preppilot.us/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://preppilot.us/privacy.html
reviewNotes:
PrepPilot is an interview-preparation app: flashcards, worked answers and a voice mock interview for practice.

SIGN-IN: Sign in with Apple or Google works; no demo account is needed. The flashcards also work without an account.

TO TEST PRO: Profile or Pricing > "Try Pro free for 3 days" (sandbox). Pro unlocks every topic, Role Ready, the full Interview Lab and 30 Live AI minutes a month.

LIVE AI: a spoken practice interview with an AI interviewer. The microphone is used only while a session the user started is running, and the session pauses when the app goes to the background. A one-time 60-minute session is sold separately.

AI CONTENT: answers come from Azure OpenAI and are for study only. Users can report a card from the card screen.
